Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for assay CHEMBL1217643. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value and standard_relation are not null. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication.
